mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tag (id, user_id, name, color, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{color}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select:
SELECT t.name AS tag, COUNT(DISTINCT r.note_id) AS count FROM note_tag_rel r JOIN tag t ON r.tag_id = t.id JOIN note n ON r.note_id = n.id WHERE n.deleted = 0
AND n.user_id = #{userId}
AND n.visibility = 1
GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY count DESC, t.name ASC
